record.evidence_quote: The obtained conductivity above 440 K is in good agreement with the experimental value (≈ 100 (S/cm))37.
record.notes: Experimental value taken from ref. 37 (Hull 2004) and used only for comparison; not measured in this paper. Mobile ion is Ag+, which is not Li or Na, so mobile_ion is 'other'. The temperature is a lower bound (above 440 K) with no single value, so the numeric field is null. The paper's own Green-Kubo conductivity (Fig. 1c) has no numeric value in the text, so no computed record was made. The 0.12 eV figure is a potential-energy change, not an activation energy, and is not recorded.
